newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian shares lose faith amid budget concern.
newsitem.headline: Italian shares lose faith amid budget concern.

text.p: Italian shares gave up early gains on Monday to close down as interest tailed off in the afternoon as concern over the budget's passage through parliament crept in and left ENI as one of the few shares to show a gain.

Shares had started cautiously higher on the back of firmer bonds, the lira and overseas share markets, but the optimistic mood soon evaporated as worries emerged over the financial budget, which had sparked the strong rally last week.
The all-share Mibtel index closed down 0.95 percent at 9,990 while the blue-chip Mib30 index of top Italian stocks was 0.93 percent lower at 15,018.
One share to stand out was energy giant ENI after the Italian Treasury announced its second tranche of shares to be floated would be less than the market had expected.

The Treasury said 8.75 percent of the group's capital was to be floated after a 15 percent tranche late last year. But the Treasury did say the stake could be increased if demand was high. ENI shares ended up 0.62 percent at 7,347 lire.
However, many blue chips were marked lower with Pirelli off 0.6 percent at 2,800 lire and Montedison down 1.22 percent at 992.7 lire while Edison eased 0.17 percent at 9,486 lire.

Shares in financial holding group Gemina rose initially after its reorganisation announced late Friday, but the shares fell on further consideration of the plan to split the company into two to close off 3.95 percent at 730.2 lire.
